selectionPolicy: Peer-reviewed journal studies and original descriptions only; citations and scope retained; no specialist signoff.

items.label: Rugose dorsal skin
items.statement: The 2007 species description reports distinctly rough dorsal and lateral skin.
items.scopeLimit: Original Mt. Lihidan sample; diagnostic characters must be combined.

items.label: Finger and toe discs
items.statement: The original diagnosis reports slightly expanded terminal discs on fingers and toes.
items.scopeLimit: Original Mt. Lihidan sample; diagnostic characters must be combined.

items.label: Tympanum and head features
items.statement: A pronounced supratympanic fold and rictal tubercle cluster accompany partly obscured tympanum margins.
items.scopeLimit: Original Mt. Lihidan sample; diagnostic characters must be combined.

items.label: Male SVL in description
items.statement: Fifteen measured males had snout–vent lengths of 27.7–34.3 mm.
items.scopeLimit: Original Mt. Lihidan sample; diagnostic characters must be combined.

items.label: Terrestrial limestone microhabitat
items.statement: The Mt. Lihidan type-population study documented a terrestrial limestone association.
items.scopeLimit: Original Mt. Lihidan sample; diagnostic characters must be combined.

items.label: Mt. Lihidan studied elevations
items.statement: The original Panay study sampled frogs at 180–300 m above sea level on Mt. Lihidan.
items.scopeLimit: Original Mt. Lihidan sample; diagnostic characters must be combined.

items.label: Later Sibuyan records
items.statement: A 2022 peer-reviewed island survey discussed reports assigned to this taxon from Sibuyan and differences from the Panay type population.
items.scopeLimit: Published Sibuyan observations do not establish island-wide occurrence.

items.label: Large body and terminal discs
items.statement: A 2016 peer-reviewed account characterizes the frog by a relatively large body and broadly expanded finger discs.
items.scopeLimit: Field character combination and calls are evidence, not a single-character key.

items.label: Repeated canopy call
items.statement: The study reports a slowly repeated pulsed call, often heard high in the forest canopy.
items.scopeLimit: Field character combination and calls are evidence, not a single-character key.

items.label: Forest canopy association
items.statement: Published surveys associate this species with forest canopy, where calling individuals can be difficult to collect.
items.scopeLimit: Field character combination and calls are evidence, not a single-character key.

items.label: Island range in 2016 review
items.statement: The authors review records from Bohol, Leyte, Samar and Mindanao.
items.scopeLimit: Field character combination and calls are evidence, not a single-character key.

items.label: Peer-reviewed island sampling
items.statement: A 2020 genomic study sampled Visayan broadbills from Bohol and Samar/Leyte populations.
items.source: Campillo et al. 2020, Biological Journal of the Linnean Society 131:814–821
items.scopeLimit: Sampled population genetic structure is not a field morphological diagnosis.

items.label: Genetic structure among islands
items.statement: Genome-wide marker analysis detected differentiation between Bohol and Samar/Leyte populations of this species.
items.source: Campillo et al. 2020, Biological Journal of the Linnean Society 131:814–821
items.scopeLimit: Sampled population genetic structure is not a field morphological diagnosis.

items.label: Original Panay sample
items.statement: The 1996 description used seven individuals collected in the Mt. Baloy–Mt. Madja-as Range of western Panay.
items.source: Gonzales and Kennedy 1996, Journal of Mammalogy 77:25–40
items.scopeLimit: Seven collected animals and five captive animals; not an abundance or all-range estimate.

items.label: Published genus comparisons
items.statement: The original paper compared this species with C. schadenbergi, C. paulus and C. australis.
items.source: Gonzales and Kennedy 1996, Journal of Mammalogy 77:25–40
items.scopeLimit: Seven collected animals and five captive animals; not an abundance or all-range estimate.

items.label: Reported predation attempt
items.statement: A 2024 field note documents a Samar Cobra attempting to prey on a Banded Bullfrog (Kaloula pulchra) on Mindanao.
items.source: Caasi, Iñigo and Gamalo 2024, Reptiles & Amphibians 31:e21403
items.sourceLocation: Published article title and field report
items.scopeLimit: One reported predation attempt, not a diet-frequency estimate.
